reply.text: Tightness in the back is one for a doctor or physio to look at, not a coach, so I'll leave the diagnosis to them. On the training side, skipping deadlifts today is a sensible call while it's tight, and I won't argue with it. If you want, tell me what's on the session and I'll help you work out what to do with the rest of it, or we can look at moving the deadlifts to a later day.
